**The symptom**

<!-- The words a person says when this problem appears. This becomes the `description`, so it must
     be greppable: error strings, UI text, counter behaviour. -->

**The non-obvious part**

<!-- What a documentation page would not tell you. If it is obvious, it is not a card. -->

**Where it came from**

<!-- The project or session, and what broke there. One or two lines. -->

**Why it recurs**

<!-- A one-off incident is a journal entry. What makes this worth a directory? -->

**Evidence already available**

<!-- Commands, measurements, counters, screenshots, a URL. -->

**Which kind**

- [ ] reasoning — a rule that replaces a misleading result
- [ ] extraction — findings from a page/bundle/store, with evidence
- [ ] instrument — a tool that produces reproducible observations
- [ ] authoring — code with measured defaults
- [ ] effect — a reproducible motion, bounded by one trigger family
